Cramorant

Flying Water

Galar · Generation 8

Cramorant is a Flying/Water-type Gulp Pokémon first found in Galar (Generation 8). It stands 0.8 m tall and weighs 18 kg. It does not evolve. Its highest base stat is Sp. Def (95), with a base stat total of 475.
